sources.what: The flag of each division of the maps, at every level they have, by its id in the game. items: the Wikidata entity whose flag it is (wd), how it was found when it is not the one the game names (by: redirect or code), the Commons file of the flag it flies today (file) and since when (from), other flags the entity gives as of today (also) and those it gives as past or less fit (old), the flag of the entity that carries its ISO 3166-2 code when that is another (other), and whether the entity is far smaller than the division (tiny). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; where the file is kept in this branch (kept); the 960 px picture that Wikimedia draws of it (picture), which stands for an original of more than 1 MB and goes with a drawing that has words in it (words); and, for a photograph, the drawing of the same flag that is kept in its place (drawn). The files themselves are under flags/files, each named after its SHA-1.
